rate-limited: ⏳ Too many requests. Please try again in {seconds} seconds.
welcome-text:
👋 Welcome to 21ID!

This bot will help you get your 21ID Card, join community chats, and more.

You will need:
- your School 21 Platform nickname (login)
- access to the email you used in Applicant

The whole process takes less than 3 minutes and is completely free. Tap the button below to start.
welcome-in-group-text:
👋 Welcome to 21ID!

This bot will help you get your 21ID Card, join community chats, and more.

The whole process takes less than 3 minutes and is completely free.

🔒 To keep your information private, please continue in a private chat with @id_21bot
start-nickname-prompt:
First, send your School 21 nickname in short form (up to 8 characters, not your full name or login).
ℹ️ For example:
daemonpr, kristana, lilliank

⚠️ School 21 and email servers can be slow. Please wait up to 10 seconds for a reply.
info-text:
🪪 21ID is an identification system for School 21 students. It helps you to:

- find peers from your campus and other campuses, and notify them via Telegram and email
- sign in to external services with your School 21 account

❓ To contribute or ask development questions, visit https://github.com/21id/bot

Made with ❤️ from SKD & TAS by daemonpr (@megaplov)
nickname-invalid:
Your nickname looks invalid. Please send it again in short form: Latin letters only, up to 8 characters.

⚠️ For example: daemonpr, kristana, lilliank
nickname-not-found:
I couldn't find you, {nickname}.

⚠️ Please check that the nickname is correct and send it again.

Examples:
daemonpr, kristana, lilliank
nickname-db-typo:
⚠️ Our database has you as {nickname}, but I can't find this nickname on the School 21 Platform.

Please send your School 21 nickname in short form (up to 8 characters, not your full name or login).
nickname-other-account-blocked:
⚠️ {nickname} is already registered to another Telegram account. We couldn't reach that account to send a migration code. It may have blocked the bot.

ℹ️ If this isn't you, send your School 21 nickname again.
nickname-migration-otp-via-email-fallbac:
⚠️ {nickname} is already registered to another Telegram account. We couldn't reach that account on Telegram.

We sent the migration code to {email} instead. Enter it below, or request a new one by email.

ℹ️ If this isn't you, send your School 21 nickname again.
nickname-resume-migration:
⚠️ {nickname} is already registered to another Telegram account.

You already have an active migration code. Enter it below, or request it by email.

ℹ️ If this isn't you, send your School 21 nickname again.
nickname-migration-otp-spoiler-msg:
⚠️ Someone is trying to move your 21ID account ({nickname}) to another Telegram account.

If this is you, your migration code is: <tg-spoiler>{otp}</tg-spoiler>

Share it only if you want to migrate your account. If this isn't you, ignore this message.
nickname-otp-prompt:
⚠️ {nickname} is already registered to another Telegram account.

We sent a migration code to that account as a spoiler message.
1. Open the message from 21ID in that account.
2. Tap the spoiler to reveal the 6-digit code.
3. Send the code here.

No access to that account? Request the code by email instead.

ℹ️ If this isn't you, send your School 21 nickname again.
nickname-otp-sent:
Thanks!
📩 Now let's confirm that you are {nickname}.

1. Open your School 21 mailbox ({email}, which forwards to your Personal Email).
2. Find the 6-digit code from 21ID.
3. Send the code here, or tap the link in the email.

⚠️ Please check your spam folder too, because the email can land there.

Want to change your nickname? Use the button below.
nickname-email-error:
❗️ Failed to send the email.

✍️ If it keeps happening, contact @megaplov (21ID developer).
nickname-email-unreachable:
⚠️ Sorry, {nickname}. We couldn't deliver your code to your mailbox. We apologize for the trouble.

ℹ️ Send your nickname again to get a new code. If it still doesn't arrive, contact @megaplov.
nickname-chat-denied:
⚠️ Sorry, {nickname}!

You can't join '{chat_title}' under its join policy:
Intensive allowed: {intensive}
Core allowed: {core}

If you think this is a mistake, contact @megaplov.

- - - - -

🪪 You can still join 21ID, just without joining {chat_title}. Follow the steps below to register.
chat-not-configured:
⚠️ Chat '{chat_title}' isn't set up in 21ID yet, so your join request was declined.

✍️ Ask the chat admins to set it up, or contact @megaplov.
verification-invalid-format:
The code is invalid. Send exactly 6 digits, with no spaces or other characters.

⚠️ For example: 812488, 123456, 000001
verification-exhausted:
Sorry, {nickname}, you've used all your attempts to enter the code.

🔄 Please start over: send /start and enter your nickname again.
verification-exhausted-join-extra: ❌ Because you were joining a chat, your join request was cancelled. Please send it again.
verification-wrong-code: ❌ The code ({code}) is wrong. Please try again. You have {remaining} attempts left.
verification-join-error:
⚠️ Something went wrong while accepting your join request.

If you haven't been accepted, contact @megaplov. If you have, you can ignore this message.
verification-db-error:
❗️ Failed to save your data.

✍️ If it keeps happening, contact @megaplov (21ID developer).
verification-success:
👋 Welcome to 21ID, {nickname}!

🔽 The main features are below. You can open the main menu any time with /start.

🪪 To find other peers, use inline mode. Guide: t.me/ident21/9
verification-nickname-taken:
⚠️ {nickname} is already registered in 21ID by another Telegram account.

✍️ If this is your account, contact @megaplov.
join-invite-not-found:
❌ Sorry, your invitation code has expired, was already used, or doesn't exist.

1. Open the invitation email.
2. Get a fresh link from it.

❓ If you think this is a mistake, contact @megaplov.
join-invite-db-error:
❗️ Failed to save your data.

✍️ If it keeps happening, contact @megaplov (21ID developer).
join-invite-success:
👋 Welcome to 21ID, {nickname}!

🔽 The main features are below. You can open the main menu any time with /start.

🪪 To find other peers, use inline mode. Guide: t.me/ident21/9
join-invite-already-registered:
⚠️ Your Telegram account is already registered in 21ID.

✍️ If you think this is a mistake, contact @megaplov.
migration-otp-expired:
⚠️ The migration code has expired or can't be found.

ℹ️ Send your School 21 nickname again to get a new code.
migration-otp-wrong:
⚠️ Wrong code. {remaining} attempt(s) left.

ℹ️ Please try again.
migration-otp-exhausted:
⚠️ You have no attempts left.

ℹ️ Start over: send your School 21 nickname again to get a new code.
migration-otp-success:
✅ Your 21ID account has been moved to your Telegram account!

You are now registered in 21ID. Welcome!
migration-old-account-notice:
⚠️ Your 21ID account ({nickname}) was moved to another Telegram account.

✍️ If this wasn't you, contact @megaplov right away.
migration-otp-email-error: Could not send the email. Please try again.
migration-otp-cancel: Cancelled. Send your School 21 nickname to start again.
communities-text: List of all public communities that are part of the 21ID ecosystem
search-usage:
How to search:
/search daemonpr - by nickname
/search @username - by Telegram username
/search 182481972 - by Telegram user ID
Or reply to a message with /search
inline-awp-in: 🖥 {nickname} is logged in to cluster {cluster} at {row}.{number}
inline-awp-out: 🖥 {nickname} is not on campus right now
inline-verified: ✅ This user is registered in 21ID, so you can contact them with the buttons below
inline-not-verified: ⚠️ This user isn't verified, but you can still try contacting them with the buttons below
inline-unregistered-hint: 🪪 Register in 21ID to see more information about students!
inline-student-awp-in: 🖥 {nickname} is logged in to cluster {cluster} at {row}.{number}
inline-student-awp-out: 🖥 {nickname} is not on campus right now
inline-student-can-invite:
❌ This student isn't registered in 21ID, so you can't contact them right away.

🪪 But you can invite them to 21ID with the button below. We'll let them know you're looking for them.
inline-student-already-invited: 📩 This student was already invited to 21ID but hasn't joined yet.
inline-student-unregistered: 🪪 Register in 21ID to see more information about students!
inline-not-found-full: No student or 21ID user matches nickname '{nickname}' (partial matches included)
notify-self: You can't send a notification to yourself, {nickname}!
notify-not-registered:
To protect our users' privacy, 21ID only sends notifications to registered users.

🪪 Register in 21ID first. It takes less than 3 minutes.
notify-target-not-found:
❌ The user you're trying to notify wasn't found.

Please start again from /start.
notify-no-telegram:
❌ This user has no linked Telegram account.

Please start again from /start.
notify-message:
🚨 IMPORTANT 🚨

Hi, {nickname}!
⚠️ {sender} ({wave}, {campus}) wants to contact you, possibly about a Peer Review.
ℹ️ Please contact them ASAP on Rocket.Chat or Telegram, or check the School 21 Platform (Edu) for incoming Peer Reviews.

⚠️ If this user is spamming you, we're sorry. Please contact @megaplov and we'll look into it.
notify-success:
✅ Notification sent to {nickname}!
⚠️ They can see your nickname and contact info.
notify-blocked: ⛔ {nickname} has blocked the 21ID bot or deleted their Telegram account. We can't reach them.
account-migration-start:
⚠️ Account Migration

This will move your 21ID registration from your current Telegram account to a new one.

Use the button below to choose the new account.
account-migration-self-error:
⚠️ You can't migrate your account to yourself.

Please choose a different Telegram account.
account-migration-taken:
⚠️ This Telegram account is already registered in 21ID.

Please choose a different account, or contact @megaplov.
account-migration-confirm-1: Are you sure you want to move your account to this Telegram user?
account-migration-confirm-2: Are you 100% sure? This can't be undone.
account-migration-confirm-3: Last chance! Are you really sure you want to do this?
account-migration-error: ⚠️ Something went wrong. Please try again.
account-migration-success:
✅ Your account has been migrated!

Please start the bot from your new Telegram account.
join-request-error:
⚠️ Something went wrong while accepting your request.

Please send a new request, or contact @megaplov.
join-request-verify:
🔗 To join '{chat_title}', you first need to verify your School 21 student status.

Tap the button below to start verification.
cancel-nothing:
There's nothing to cancel, but okay!

✅ Cancelled.
cancel-join-extra: Because you were joining a chat, I cancelled your join request. You can try to join again, or verify yourself with /start.
invite-not-verified: ⚠️ Only verified 21ID users can send invitations.
invite-already-exists: This user has already been invited or is already registered.
invite-failed: ⚠️ Couldn't send the invitation to {nickname}. Please try again later.
mass-invite-start:
🪪 Mass-invite link

1. Send School 21 nicknames separated by commas. You can send several messages.
2. Press ✅ Done to get the link.

⚠️ For example: daemonpr, kristana, lilliank
mass-invite-empty: ⚠️ The list is empty. Send at least one nickname first.
mass-invite-created:
✅ Link created for {count} students. It works for 30 days.

{url}
mass-invite-not-found:

✍️ Contact @megaplov and briefly describe the problem.
